निधिः [नि-धा-आधारे कि]

receptacle, reservoir; जल˚, तोय˚,

--2 A store-house,
treasury.
--3 A treasure, store, hoard,
(for the nine treasures of Kubera,
see नवनिधि).
--4 The ocean.
--5 An
epithet of Viṣṇu.
--6 A man
endowed with many good qualities.
--Comp.
--ईशः, --नाथः an epithet of
Kubera.
